name: Australian Units, Levels and Buildings
description: A unit before a slash (Australia's own 3/12), a unit written with its type (AS4590's flat and unit types: Unit, Flat, Apartment, Shop, Suite, Villa, Townhouse and the rest), a level or floor (AS4590's level types), and a building's name on a line of its own. Original cases written for this corpus from Australia Post's guidelines and AS4590, described in our own words; nothing copied.
